question: Should OpenClaw adopt this reusable signed publisher-feed verifier and transport as a core foundation before the linked persistence and follow-management slices are ready?
rationale: The patch is technically scoped, but it creates a reusable core trust boundary and product direction cannot be inferred from contributor tests or the external producer stack.

options.title: Sponsor the core foundation
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical verifier/transport slice, subject to real producer-backed proof and an explicit compatibility contract for the shared verifier.

options.title: Keep the capability external for now
options.body: Pause the core transport until a plugin or ClawHub-owned integration demonstrates the required consumer boundary and lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core foundation
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical verifier/transport slice, subject to real producer-backed proof and an explicit compatibility contract for the shared verifier.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contact spanning this PR and the linked publisher-feed stack; an OpenClaw owner should make the final product decision.
